continuous_text.title: Play Time Is Cool!
continuous_text.content:
We like play time at our school.
Singing and dancing,
Throwing and catching.
Play time is cool at our school!

I'm throwing the ball.
It's so much fun!
Are you
Hitting and running?
Yes, and it's fun.

We're kicking the ball
And trying to score.
It's so much fun.
Let's play some more.
Chorus

continuous_text.title: I'm Not Tired!
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1:
Mrs. Smith: Hi, Ann.
Ann: Hi, Mrs. Smith.
Frame 2:
Mrs. Smith: Thanks for babysitting, Ann. Is Tim sleeping?
Ann: No, he isn't, Mrs. Smith.
Frame 3:
Mrs. Smith: Is Patrick sleeping?
Ann: No, he isn't. He's jumping on the bed.
Frame 4:
Ann: Tim! Patrick! Let's go to bed!
Tim: I'm not tired!
Patrick: I'm not tired!
Frame 5:
Mrs. Smith: Are they sleeping now?
Ann: No, they aren't. They're dancing.
Frame 6:
Mrs. Smith: It's quiet now! Are they sleeping?
Ann: Yes, they are!
continuous_text.notes: Frames 1-4 on p. 152; frames 5-6 on p. 153; track 238

continuous_text.title: Content Connection: Playground Games
continuous_text.content:
1 Playing games with my friends is a lot of fun. We play in the school playground.
2 We climb to the top of the bars. Up! Up! Up! We also jump rope. My friends jump very fast. Jump! Jump! Jump!
3 We play hide and seek, too. I count to ten, then I look for my friends. 1, 2, 3... Where are you?
4 We also play hopscotch. Hop! Hop! Hop!
5 My favorite game of all is tag. Let's run! Run! Run! Tag, you're it!

continuous_text.title: Culture Connection: Rock, Paper, Scissors
continuous_text.content:
1 I'm Eva. I'm nine. I play Rock, Paper, Scissors in Canada. I play with my sisters and my best friend, Tina. I always win.
2 I'm Michio. I'm seven. I'm from Japan. I play this game at school with my friends. We call it Janken. I sometimes win.
3 I'm Raúl. I'm eight. I'm from Chile. We play this game, too. We call it Cachipún. My brother, Martin, is the best player in our family.
